line: A borrowed oil lamp walks along a cave wall; every register it passes wakes from weathered plaster to its first colour, and when the flame sinks the wall remembers.
line_cn: 借来的一盏油灯沿着洞窟墙壁走过，灯光所到之处，褪色的壁画一层层醒回最初的颜色；火苗落下时，墙还记得。
uses: Silk-road, tea and craft origin stories
uses_cn: 丝绸之路、茶和工艺的起源故事
节日、书法与纹样设计品牌
